acceptanceCriteria: npm run lint, npm test and npm run build were each run by QA on Node 22 with exit codes explicitly captured (build in a copy of the tree, once online and once with network blocked), output tails recorded (348 tests or more; / route First Load JS within 2 kB of 125 kB), and the bundle proof holds: the / route chunks contain no rapier, character-controller, game scene or /game/clips/ references, and loading and scrolling / without hovering Play issues no game chunk, rapier or clips request.

The working-tree diff against afd4f0f was inspected: only files named in reports 15 and 17 changed, design section 9 do-not-touch files are unchanged, hero edits in TalkingAvatar.tsx are limited to the transition shell as described in report 15, and new content has no em dash or machine-local path.

The Play transition was recorded (DevTools protocol screencast or per-frame captures at 1440x900 on a real GPU, both warm after hover and cold without hover, at scroll 0 and a scrolled offset) and judged by eye and by frame diff: every page chrome element fades and slides out with a visible stagger, no layout jump, no hard cut, no blank frame, no T-pose or bind-pose frame, no flash of the hero layout, the avatar turns and walks into the world while the camera settles behind, the HUD fades in, input is enabled by about 2 s after click, and rAF frame time p95 is under 20 ms during the transition; the Boss's noted weak spots (title still about 14 percent opaque at C+360, exit swap pose step 1.9x neighbours) are judged visible or invisible with evidence.

Exit restores the exact pre-Play layout, scroll position (0 and scrolled) and focus on Play with a whole-frame pixel diff; the inline loading strip appears only when assets are held past 400 ms, Cancel and Escape return to the hero, and the sequence resumes without replaying the chrome exit; reduced motion yields a crossfade with no travel; the mobile emulation shows touch controls fading in and a tap skipping the entry.

Pause (Escape, P), Resume, tab-hide auto-pause, Play from an active voice session releasing the microphone, and the four failure paths (chunk blocked, clips blocked, WebAssembly rejected, context lost) behave as report 15 claims, each reproduced by QA, and the regular portfolio is usable after every failure.

Ten Play and Exit cycles and five Play and Cancel cycles leave listener and DOM node counts identical and heap growth after warmup within a few percent, with the numbers recorded; hero camera, gestures, head-follow and talk still work afterwards.

No Milestone 1 regression: ramp, steps, wall, walk, run, jump, fall and hard landing behave as approved in QA round 3 (spot checks with screenshots), and the self-hosted font renders identically (pixel diff of hero and a content section against the Google-font build, antialiasing noise only) with both woff2 files preloaded and no flash of unstyled text.

Every finding is reported with file, line, severity, trigger, consequence, evidence and rule, and the verdict is approved only if every criterion above passed; owner-deferred camera findings F7, F8 and the Codex minDistance finding are not grounds for rejection.
